<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The user wants me to send a confirmation email for a meeting.
Alison has confirmed that Monday at 11:00 AM works for everyone, even though there's a soft conflict for Priya. She has made the decision to book it.
My task is to send the confirmation email.

I need to extract the details from Alison's message:
- Day: Monday, November 16
- Time: 11:00 AM
- Duration: 30 minutes

The body of the email should be professional and confirm these details. I will mention that this is a meeting for all four partners. I will list their names to be clear.

My plan is to use the `send_confirmation_email` function with the correct parameters.
- `day`: "Mon"
- `start`: "11:00"
- `body`: A professional email confirming the meeting details for all four partners.

After sending the email, my part of the task is complete. I will then end my session.I've received the go-ahead from Alison. The meeting is scheduled for Monday at 11:00 AM. I will now send the confirmation email to all four partners.

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments:
{"day":"Mon","start":"11:00","body":"Dear Partners,

This email confirms a 30-minute meeting has been scheduled for all four of you: Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto and David Okafor.

The meeting will take place on Monday, November 16, from 11:00 AM to 11:30 AM Eastern.

Best regards,
Brad
Scheduling Assistant"}
